configurations.name: app-web
runtimeArgs: import os, runpy, sys; sys.argv = ['http.server', os.environ.get('PORT', '8765'), '--directory', 'app/build/web']; runpy.run_module('http.server', run_name='__main__')

configurations.name: wisi-worker
runtimeArgs: cd worker && npx wrangler dev --port 8787 --local-upstream localhost:8787

configurations.name: wisi-gateway
runtimeArgs: import os, uvicorn; uvicorn.run('app.main:app', app_dir='backend', port=int(os.environ.get('PORT', '8001')), reload=True, reload_dirs=['backend/app'])

configurations.name: wisi-worker
runtimeArgs: cd worker && eval "$(fnm env)" && fnm use 22 >/dev/null && npx wrangler dev --port 8787 --host localhost
